selection.review_method: All 165 candidate thumbnails reviewed. Source XML contains no objects (India/Czech) or no D40 (China). Visible suspicious road damage, ambiguous roadside material and redundant similar China views excluded. Plain cracks, sealed repairs, road paint, shadows, manhole covers and dusty roads are background for CivicEye targets. Seeded selection with no exact/perceptual candidate pairs among selected negatives. Whole country remains in existing split. This is visual inspection, not certainty about invisible distant objects.
